verdict.rationale: LangSmith's own materials say it integrates with any agent stack through official Python, TypeScript, Go, or Java SDKs [langsmith-docs-24], and that tracing can be added via the SDK [langsmith-docs-40]. The official langsmith-sdk repo shows Python instrumentation (`wrap_openai`) and native integration with both LangChain Python and LangChain JS [langsmith-gh-1, langsmith-gh-3], and a community user independently describes using the Python `@traceable` decorator on custom functions [langsmith-comm-2-refresh-c22006912c3d93cf]. Missing for 10: in-depth JS/TS SDK instrumentation docs or code samples beyond a one-line mention, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the JS/TS SDK.
